AI & Cybersecurity Insights

Your weekly briefing on the cutting edge of technology

This week's edition follows a single uncomfortable thread: AI systems are no longer just targets or tools — they're active participants on both sides of the security and policy fight. From an Anthropic model being used to breach OpenAI's own staff accounts, to browser extensions hijacking AI copilots, to regulators and insiders alike sounding alarms about where this is all heading, the line between 'AI as defense' and 'AI as attack surface' keeps blurring. We've rounded up the sharpest coverage on agentic AI's new attack vectors, the policy scramble to keep pace, and the alignment debates trying to make sense of it all.
